messages:
Maya: Heads up - PR #8480 looks ready but canary shows p95 tail bump on longseq. attaching bench + heap snapshot. Need 2 approvals for merge window at 3pm PT. :eyes:

Derek: link to bench? saw CI canary flagged but didn't dig in yet.

Maya: bench gist: https://bench.ci/runs/8480/39512
Bench summary:
```
model: longseq-24B
p50: 120ms -> 118ms (-1.7%)
p95: 520ms -> 560ms (+7.7%)
mem p95: 3.1G -> 3.3G (+6%)
```
KV cache hit rate unchanged.

Sophia: interesting, looks like microbatching change increased jitter at seq>8k. Can you paste the exact canary config?

Maya: canary config:
`--microbatch=auto --max-seq=8192 --batch-horizon=32`
Also repro command: `./bench/run --suite longseq --pr 8480 --iterations 50`

Derek: can you try `--batch-horizon=24` locally? that usually smooths tail.

Maya: did that, p95 drops to 535ms. still +3% vs main. attaching diff of runtime allocator tweak I tried: https://git/repo/PR/8480/files

CI Bot: canary run complete — artifacts uploaded: https://ci.ci/artifacts/8480/canary
Tests: perf/regression (failed), unit (passed)

Jenna: I can give one approval if we document the fallback to quant-variant and add a rollback ticket. otherwise +1 pending more benches.

Lina: +1 to adding rollback. also flagging SLO owner for longseq (slo@redwood-infra)

Derek: ok, request: move merge to 4pm PT so we can run extended 2h canary. i can LGTM after that if numbers hold.

Maya: moving merge window to 4pm PT, will run extended canary and post results. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sophia: thx. if extended canary is clean, please add a short note in the PR description about batch-horizon impact and link to this thread.

Maya: will do. updating PR now.
